narration.text: Can AI truly narrate a full audiobook for less than £10?

First up, voice quality! ElevenLabs delivers incredibly natural, emotional voices, even letting you clone your own. Its customisation is just next-level, making it perfect for long-form content. Speechify is good, but ElevenLabs just sounds more human. No contest here!

Next, the cost for audiobooks. ElevenLabs offers a generous free tier for personal projects, then you pay per character. Speechify runs on a subscription model, giving you 100,000 characters monthly. For serious audiobook creation, ElevenLabs' pricing is far more scalable. Ouch!

ElevenLabs takes the win overall for its superior voice quality and flexible pricing, making it ideal for audiobook creators. Speechify is still great for quick listens! Which one would you pick for your next project?
